historical_parent.lesson: absence of independent evidence is not negative evidence of absence

scientific_problem: A causal harmonic suppressor must distinguish a newly played fundamental from an already active source harmonic without converting observational non-identifiability into a forced binary decision.
hypothesis: A four-outcome causal resolver can support a new fundamental only from an identifiable positive certificate, reject a bounded candidate claim only from an identifiable negative certificate, preserve AMBIGUOUS whenever neither certificate exists or two causes are observationally equivalent, and reserve ALREADY_ACTIVE_HISTORY for pitches already active in causal decoder state.
single_change_from_h25: replace the generic no-new-energy implies NO_BIRTH branch with explicit positive and negative certificates separated by an ambiguity region; do not claim that an arbitrarily weak physical source can be disproved

outcome_semantics.BIRTH_SUPPORTED: The candidate is inactive and a valid positive certificate contains causal observation components that cannot be explained by any allowed active-source-only hypothesis.
outcome_semantics.NO_BIRTH: The candidate is inactive and a valid negative certificate falsifies the preregistered bounded candidate claim. This means the declared minimum detectable candidate contribution is absent under valid support; it does not assert that no arbitrarily weak physical vibration exists.
outcome_semantics.AMBIGUOUS: The allowed observations do not identify either a positive certificate or a negative certificate, or at least two allowed latent causes are observation-equivalent. AMBIGUOUS is a terminal one-hop outcome, never a hidden binary decision.
outcome_semantics.ALREADY_ACTIVE_HISTORY: The candidate pitch was already active before the proposal according to causal decoder history. It is not a new-source birth decision and bypasses the positive/negative certificate rules.

decision_order: if candidate_pitch is active in the preregistered causal history, return ALREADY_ACTIVE_HISTORY
if required observation support or validity masks are invalid, return AMBIGUOUS
if an observation-equivalence certificate exists, return AMBIGUOUS
if and only if the positive certificate is complete, return BIRTH_SUPPORTED
if and only if the negative certificate is complete, return NO_BIRTH

non_identifiability_rule.statement: Two allowed latent causes that produce byte-identical allowed observations, masks and causal state must receive AMBIGUOUS.
non_identifiability_rule.priority: overrides positive and negative scalar heuristics
non_identifiability_rule.required_collision_design: Each exact-collision explanation must contain a nonzero source contribution and the two complete latent decompositions must independently synthesize the same allowed observation bytes.

bounded_candidate_claim.meaning: A proposal eligible for a negative certificate asserts at least the preregistered minimum observable candidate contribution on support not explainable by active sources.
bounded_candidate_claim.claim_origin: The lower bound must be computed causally from the proposal's observed shared-band amplitude and a preregistered synthetic timbre lower envelope. It may not come from fixture family, expected outcome, labels or a caller-supplied per-fixture constant.
bounded_candidate_claim.scope: This is a synthetic bounded-timbre claim only and does not establish a universal lower bound for real guitars.

exclusive_support_rule.definition: A candidate partial is exclusive only when its complete tolerance band does not intersect any preregistered partial band of any causally active source.

includes: candidate contribution below the preregistered detection floor

causal_contract.long_view_role: persistence decay and active-source context only
causal_contract.short_view_role: current onset novelty exclusive support and candidate residual evidence

allowed_inputs: current and previous 4096-sample views ending on causal hops
current and previous 8192-sample views ending on the same causal hops

measurement_definitions.analysis_dtype: float64 for every sample, window, FFT operand, power, kernel, sum, dot product and certificate component

window_extraction.padding: forbidden; any missing required sample marks that view invalid

spectrum.view_length_symbols: L=4096 for short views; L=8192 for long views
spectrum.zero_padding: n_fft=8*L; append exactly 7*L positive float64 zeros after the causal view. This changes frequency sampling only and never reads audio beyond the view.
spectrum.power: P_L[k]=(real(X[k])^2+imag(X[k])^2)/sum_m(w_L[m]^2), evaluated float64 in ascending m then ascending k order
spectrum.total_power: T_L=sum_{k=1..4*L} P_L[k] in ascending-k float64 order

partial_band_kernel.band_energy: E_N(target)=sum_k P_N[k]*K(f_N[k],target) in ascending-k float64 order
partial_band_kernel.exclusive_definition: a candidate band is exclusive only if its K>0 bin set has empty intersection with every K>0 bin set for harmonics 1..8 of every causally active pitch

exclusive_energy_ratio.denominator: current short-view total power T_4096, DC excluded
exclusive_energy_ratio.positive_test: at least two exclusive h have Q_h>=0.02
exclusive_energy_ratio.negative_observation_test: the same at-least-two preregistered exclusive h each have Q_h<=0.002
exclusive_energy_ratio.overlap_between_candidate_bands: allowed, but each physical FFT bin contributes separately to each preregistered Q_h and never to T_4096 more than once

harmonic_basis.column_formula: b_p[k]=sum_{h=1..8}(1/h^2)*K(f_4096[k],h*F0(p)) for k=1..16384 on the short-view n_fft=32768 grid
harmonic_basis.normalization: divide each nonzero column by sqrt(sum_k b_p[k]^2) in ascending-k float64 order
harmonic_basis.invalid_column: a zero or nonfinite column invalidates the residual measurement

nnls_fixed_v1.algorithm: exactly 512 cyclic coordinate-descent sweeps; in each sweep visit columns in ascending MIDI pitch; for column j set a_j=max(0,a_j+dot(b_j,y-Ba)/dot(b_j,b_j)); recompute residual y-Ba in ascending-k order after every coordinate update

support_normalized_pitch_dilution_residu.pitch_grid: integer MIDI pitches 24..96 inclusive in ascending order
support_normalized_pitch_dilution_residu.formula: C[p]=max(0,R(active_pitches)-R(sorted(active_pitches union {p})))/max(R(active_pitches),1e-24), using NNLS_FIXED_V1 independently for every p
support_normalized_pitch_dilution_residu.support_normalization: Both R terms use the same current valid short-view y and its normalized squared-residual denominator; invalid views mask the complete curve.
support_normalized_pitch_dilution_residu.role: C is an allowed diagnostic operand; no raw transform-disappearance index, fixture identity or expected category may enter it.

global_synthetic_timbre_v1.shared_band: candidate H1 partial band under the same 35-cent triangular kernel
global_synthetic_timbre_v1.bounded_claim_valid: at least two exclusive h have finite L_h>=0.02 and at least three valid bins
global_synthetic_timbre_v1.negative_margin: for the same h, require finite Q_h<=0.002 and L_h/Q_h>=10; define L_h/Q_h=+infinity only when Q_h is exact positive float64 0.0
global_synthetic_timbre_v1.source_of_bound: S and the single global profile only; fixture category, expected outcome, labels and caller-provided per-fixture constants forbidden

long_window_persistence.role: diagnostic and validity context only; D is not by itself a positive or negative certificate

P2_GAIN_V1.application: multiply every non-noise source amplitude in a fixture by the same scale before mixing

P2_PHASE_V1.application: replace the declared common source phase; exact-collision paired components always receive the same phase

P2_NOISE_V1.seed: unsigned little-endian uint64 from the first 8 digest bytes of SHA256(UTF8('H26|' + fixture_id + '|P2-003|' + colour + '|' + decimal_snr_db_string))
P2_NOISE_V1.pink: from the same ungated white vector z: Z=rfft(z); Z[0]=0; Z[k]=Z[k]/sqrt(k) for k>=1; irfft(Z,n=16640)
P2_NOISE_V1.normalization: subtract mean on support only, normalize to unit RMS on support only, assign exact positive 0.0 outside support, then scale to clean-support RMS*10^(-snr_db/20)

P2_CENTS_INHARMONICITY_V1.application: Apply the same cell's cents and B to every synthesized source partial and to every candidate/active partial-band center and harmonic-basis center used to analyze that cell.

P2_HOP_SHIFT_V1.application: shift every source onset, causal transition, target hop, resolution hop and validity-mask boundary by the same sample shift; no clipping or padding

comparison.exact_collision_within_each_runtime: paired latent arrays byte-identical <f8 within that runtime
comparison.exact_collision_across_runtimes: numeric tolerance applies; cross-runtime waveform-byte identity is not required
comparison.nan_or_infinity: forbidden except the explicitly defined negative-margin ratio when Q_h is exact positive 0.0

P2_RUNTIME_V1.authority_boundary: These identities and tolerances are declarative test operands only. They do not reuse H25 authority, executable observer, transport, claim or consumption state, and do not authorize either runtime.

preregistered_metrics: false forced-binary count on ambiguous fixtures

phase_plan.P0: validate schema, causal boundaries, certificate semantics, non-identifiability, leakage exclusions and independent recomputation before category claims
phase_plan.P1: evaluate all preregistered positive, negative, active-history and ambiguous fixture families without family-average compensation
phase_plan.P2: evaluate preregistered gain, phase, noise, cents, inharmonicity, pitch-band, permutation, runtime and causal-boundary robustness
